description: This visual allows you to embed rich documentation and diagrams in your Power BI reports using standard Markdown syntax and Mermaid diagram notation. It's perfect for: - display any kind of formatted text - Embedding documentation directly in Power BI reports - Visualising mermaid diagrams such as flowcharts, process diagrams and entity relationship diagrams Find the whole documentation and the source code on github: - Source code: https://github.com/pmoldmann/mermaid-powerbi/tree/Version_1_3_1_1 - documentation: https://github.com/pmoldmann/mermaid-powerbi/blob/Version_1_3_1_1/README.md This visual is a free offer from semadoc.io, the professional solution to get all you semantic models documented into a unified, browsable data catalog for the whole organisation.
